Rheumatology Follow-up
Patient: Kenji Jaramillo | DOB: 05/10/1981 | MRN: SYN-8585869
Date of service: 04/25/2025 | Dr. Kaveh Jessop, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
43-year-old man with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2024, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: gastroesophageal reflux, hypertension.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
Methotrexate 15 mg weekly was stopped after 13 weeks because of persistent transaminase elevation (intolerance).

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis with high disease activity, CDAI 32.
Pre-biologic screening: tuberculosis and hepatitis B screens negative.
Plan: start fictimab 160 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
